methods_quotes.q: Average 7-year rates were calculated by dividing the sum of the yearly numerator estimates by the sum of the yearly denominator estimates.
Variances of the estimates were pooled to calculate 95% CIs.
For SOII, relative standard errors were converted to 95% CIs.
Because of missing race/ethnicity data (approximately 32% in NEISS-Work and 45% in SOII), injuries by race/ethnicity were not examined.
